items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gladys was my wife – first wife – was at Wendell Philips High School.

ctx.x: Can you tell us about meeting Gladys?

Gladys was my wife – first wife – was at Wendell Philips High School. She was a very athletic young girl. She was president of a club. In those days, here again, the social life of a lot of the black people at that time was through clubs. Each – just like my mother. She was – had these clubs and they’d have these affairs. Gladys belonged to a club that had an affair – money- raising affairs and everything, and a social. There was a social. A group of the girls that were together at Wendell Philips High School…
I just want you to explain a little bit more about when your mother passed away, what that did to your life in terms of how you felt and what it did to your family.
